Job Description

Would you like to work with Cyber Security for Industrial Systems in a company that develops and maintains highly complex, mission critical systems for a global market? Then take this opportunity to create something that matters.

Join us to apply your expertise within Cyber Security of complex software products and projects for logistics centres and airports worldwide. Take on this exciting and demanding leadership challenge to help us deliver integrated Cyber Security for vital infrastructure solutions.

Join a software center of excellence

You join BEUMER Group to become responsible for our Cyber Security activities for our portfolio of technically complex software products and projects for automated baggage handling systems and parcel sorters. These mission critical systems are installed across international airports and logistics centers as a completely essential part of daily operations 24/7/365. We have the leading products on the market, and the office in Aarhus, Denmark, is an international center of excellence within the BEUMER organization.

Cyber Security for industrial systems

Specifically, you become responsible for monitoring and implementing best practices within Cyber Security for industrial systems. Focus is on Cyber Security for the systems that we deliver to our customers. We comply with internationally recognized standards and have a process-oriented approach as Cyber Security is part of all aspects of what we do.

You will have a close dialogue with both our software product organization and our software project organization and our project IT-Infrastructure team. You will quite naturally be working closely with our Software Process Improvement department, and you will report to the Global Software Director.

Leader of a specialist team

You will be leading a small team of highly professional cyber security specialists while at the same time driving cyber security across BEUMERs global software team in close collaboration with BEUEMRs CISO team. As such you will be in dialog with group companies and product and project departments coordinating cyber security initiatives and communicating Cyber Security strategy, roadmap and best practices.

Skilled in Cyber Security

As responsible for our Cyber Security activities, your task is to enable the organization to deliver Cyber Secure software products, projects and services needed for mission critical systems. To do so, we believe you:

• Have a relevant master’s degree related to software development and/or cyber security

• Experience in analyzing a software organization's cybersecurity priorities and practices

• You have at least 2 years’ of relevant experience in the cybersecurity field.

• Previous work experience with applying or using frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, EU CRA, NIS2 and ISO27001/2 in an international environment.

• Relevant security certifications (CISSP, CCSK etc.) are a plus

Other than that, we would also like you to:

• Be structured, factual and have well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills with practical ability to shape the Cybersecurity agenda.

• Thrive in a fast-paced international environment with many stakeholders

• Have a good understanding of technologies and methodologies within software development

• Possess solid leadership skills and strong in stakeholder management and communication knowing how to create buy-in and setting direction.

• Have knowledge about agile software development processes, CMMI and similar methods and standards would be an advantage.

• Be PMI, IPMA or Prince2 certified or similar training/certification would be a plus.

Some travel must be expected as we are an international organisation. Therefore we expect you to communicate fluently in English.

To lead our cyber security activities, you will in addition to the above need drive, energy, and good commutation and stakeholder management skills. You have the experience to facilitate improvement initiatives and implement changes in an organization.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, serration and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

• 
We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

• 
During our immersive onboarding program in, you will receive an extensive overview of BEUMER Group, our history, and our vision for the future, whilst also getting to know your new colleagues.

• 
Through a culture of open feedback, transparent corporate updates, and regular employee events, we actively cultivate a friendly, open, and collaborative working environment

• 
Your personal and professional growth is integral to our ethos. We champion your development through a wide range of training courses and upskilling opportunities — including support for external courses and grants for trainees.

• 
Flexible working hours and the choice of operating from a remote office are important components of our modern work culture, much like our bright, spacious offices and ergonomically optimized workstations.

• 
Your health matters to us. Enjoy free access to our on-site fitness centre and join one of our many sports clubs for a healthier, more connected work-life. We also provide computer glasses subsidies, vegetarian lunch options, and free fresh fruit to help boost your well-being.

• 
You will get access to Denmark’s largest discount portal, and receive exclusive discounts and promotional offers from a wide-range of companies and businesses.

• 
From accident insurance to attractive company pension schemes and health insurance for you and your children, we are committed to supporting your long-term well-being.

• 
Supporting you when you are not in work is also important to us. Our Staff Association organizes and sponsors social, cultural, and sporting activities, including our annual Christmas and Summer parties, which are always great fun.

• 
Sustainability is one of our key core values, which we tackle on multiple fronts. For example, you will have access to our electric charging stations in the employee parking area, with the electricity being provided at cost price.

• 
Fair pay is extended to all our employees, and we ensure we provide a balanced and equitable remuneration framework. You will also receive a number of additional salary benefits that combine to form an attractive salary package.

• 
Everyone needs a rest and a break from work at some point. That is why you will receive 30 days of vacation days per year, as well as various other special holiday days. We also provide extra support for maternity and paternity leave.

jobs.occupation: Electronics/Firmware Engineer for Medical Laser Company
jobs.description:
Reporting to the R&D manager, your tasks will be highly diversified and will include:

• Define, describe, and design electronics of new and existing products

• Identify and integrate electronic modules into systems

• Analyze malfunctions or handle part replacements or re-designs

• Verify designs and design integrations to raise product quality

• Be an active part of the R&D team on development projects and support existing products

• Write and review Software

• Prepare required documents due to regulatory and quality measurement required for medical devices

Candidate profile:

Your qualifications should include a technical background with a preference for system analysis or technical exposure, preferably including:

• An engineering degree or equivalent work experience required

• Experienced with electronics circuit and PCB layout design

• Experienced with firmware development in C/C++

• Handling the PCB and electronics supply chain (ordering, BOM’s, documentation)

• Experienced with Design for Electrical Safety and EMC testing

• Excellent technical oral and written skills in English

Furthermore, the ideal candidate would have experience with

• IEC 60601 and ISO 13485 standards

• Digital communication standards such as USB, CAN Bus, SPI, …

• Lasers and Optics ERP systems (NAV)

• User interfaces

• Making test setups for HW and SW verification and validation

• Experience with Altium Designer

You will be part of a small, dedicated team. Therefore, we expect you to be an independent and flexible co-worker with the ability to overview multiple tasks, while keeping up quality, structure and good teamwork. In return, you are offered flexible working hours and a strong influence on how your job is carried out.

Innovative and ambitious mobile health company seeks ambitious IT specialist to support our global growth.

MONSENSO is a passionate team dedicated to designing innovative personal health technology that helps people, care providers and societies overcome the burden of mental illness.

In continuation of the Monsenso’s growth and thus increased activities, we are looking for an IT Specialist to join our team. At Monsenso we value the partnership between IT and business, and we expect you as our new colleague to be both flexible and proactive, and even seeking new ways to optimize and improve our systems and processes.

In addition to collaboration with colleagues, suppliers and partners your work will consist of tasks with administration, maintenance, operation, support and capacity planning.

We offer an exciting work in an international company with pride in the products and respect for each other, and we emphasize high professionalism, deadlines and initiative. The tone is informal with focus on progress and results.

Key responsibilities

· As an IT Development & Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for planning and handling our efforts related to:

Ensuring that the production network is safe and secure

● Ensuring the IT systems and software in the Monsenso solution are functioning at peak efficiency

● Communicating planned changes or upgrades

● Escalating incidents to partners and IT colleagues

● Ensuring system efficiencies and uptime

Essential Skills and Expertise

As a person you are structured and solution-oriented. We expect that you are fluent in English, both written and spoken. You are able to understand the customer value of the solutions we offer, and you focus on how we can best contribute to future opportunities and innovation. You must have well-developed interpersonal skills and abilities to use and support your new colleagues.

You have an educational background in IT or similar professional certification and minimum 3 years experience, but the right graduates with proven skills may also be considered.

We expect the successful candidate to master the following:

● Networking and troubleshooting

● Continuous software integration systems such as Jenkins

● Managing document oriented databases

● Active Directory management

It is a further plus if you have experience with one or more of the following points:

● Support of development (e.g. Application rollouts)

● Agile methodologies and continuous integration

● Monitoring tools

● Documentation

What we offer

We offer a fantastic opportunity to join a young growth company, where you truly have the ability to make an impact and help shape the future in an exciting field. Personal health technology and mHealth are booming markets worldwide, and you will be at the center of this technology revolution. Mental health is as a major burden for society needing new solutions and ways of supporting treatment, and you will contribute to reducing this burden for the benefit of society and the people affected.

You should expect an informal, fast-paced environment with tremendous opportunities for personal development for the right people.

Note: Candidates without an EU work permit and less than two years of experience will not be considered.

****What We Offer

****At Devote Consulting, we offer a position where you can take responsibility, influence outcomes, and make a difference in your everyday work. You’ll lead one or more projects as a specialist, business analyst, or project manager, collaborating with clients to drive meaningful change in the pharmaceutical industry.

****Ready to Join Us?

****We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to a recruitment process that ensures equal opportunities for all applicants. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply today!
